items.name: The Horizontal Pod Autoscaler
items.explanation: In Kubernetes, the autoscaler watches a workload and adds or removes copies (pods) to match demand. When traffic drops it scales down, which matters for the cold start Zalando describes.

assumedBy.quote: With barely 5 requests per second coming in, the Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) has scaled the service to a minimum of only three pods.

items.name: Traces and spans
items.explanation: A trace follows one request through every service it touches. Each step in it is a span with a start time and a duration, so you can see where the time went.

assumedBy.quote: Standard trace tooling gives you one trace at a time, in a waterfall view.

items.name: Reverse proxies
items.explanation: A reverse proxy sits in front of servers, receives requests and passes them on. Proxying is commonly used to spread load across several servers.

assumedBy.quote: Individual span latencies during the half-open probe phase: 15 ms at the client, 10 ms at the reverse-proxy, 2 ms on the service. All healthy.
